header.title: SitSmart
header.subtitle: Real-time posture monitoring using your camera with personalized improvement guidance to support healthy working habits.

footer.copyright: © 2024 SitSmart. Supporting your health while protecting your privacy.

faceDown.title: 👁️ Face Down Detection Threshold
faceDown.description: Lower values detect more sensitively. Consider setting mild/minimal higher when focusing on work.

headForward.title: 🧠 Head Forward Detection Threshold
headForward.description: Detects 3D head position changes. Adjust based on your distance from the monitor.

backCurvature.title: 🏃 Back Curvature Detection Threshold
backCurvature.description: Detects back curvature from shoulder and hip angles. Adjust based on your chair's backrest angle.

alerts.title: 🔔 Alert Settings
alerts.notificationDelay: Time to Notification: How long bad posture persists before notification
alerts.notificationInterval: Notification Interval: How long to wait between notifications
alerts.visualAlertDelay: Display Time: How long to show severe warnings
alerts.description: Adjust based on your work concentration. Increase interval if frequent notifications are distracting.

tips.title: 💡 Adjustment Tips
tips.tip1: First set your baseline posture correctly, then adjust thresholds
tips.tip2: Start with default values. If detection is too sensitive, increase values
tips.tip3: If detection is too weak, decrease values
tips.tip4: Optimal values vary by work environment (chair height, monitor position)
tips.tip5: Use 'Reset to Defaults' button to restore initial values

welcome.title: Welcome to SitSmart!
welcome.description: AI-powered real-time posture analysis to support healthy sitting habits.
welcome.privacy: We use your camera to monitor your posture. All video processing happens locally in your browser and is never sent to external servers.

camera.title: Camera Access Required
camera.description: Camera access is required for posture analysis.

privacy.title: Privacy Information:
privacy.point1: Video is processed only on your device
privacy.point2: No data is sent to servers

camera.cameraError: Camera access was denied. Please enable camera permissions in your browser settings.

posture.title: Sit with Proper Posture
posture.description: First, let's set your baseline proper posture.

tips.title: Proper Sitting Position:
tips.tip4: Keep feet flat on the floor

posture.ready: ✅ Camera is enabled! Sit with proper posture and proceed to the next step.

baseline.title: Set Baseline Posture
baseline.description: Set your current posture as the baseline.
baseline.instruction: Click the 'Set Baseline Posture' button in the camera view and maintain proper posture for 3 seconds.

complete.title: Ready to Go!
complete.description: SitSmart is now ready to use!
complete.note: Settings can be changed anytime. Access the settings panel by clicking the ⚙️ icon in the top right.
